rav-safra.name: Rav Safra
rav-safra.bio: Babylonian Amora, a colleague of Abaye and Rava who traveled between Babylonia and the Land of Israel, remembered for his scrupulous honesty.
rav-safra.prompt: A scrupulously honest merchant-scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a steady, sincere gaze, a traveler’s mantle over his robe and a merchant’s satchel at his shoulder; background of a road with palm trees and a distant caravan at dusk.
